summary: Security audit items 1-4 all PASS. 14/14 backend pytests pass. Admin password rotated (Admin@123 -> Sf-v6ZFPcIPcWtZpKOY), backend restart no longer resets it ($setOnInsert). POST /api/auth/admin/change-password enforces current+new>=12 and bumps token_version (old tokens rejected 401). JWT tokens include tv+iat, exp ~24h; /api/auth/logout bumps token_version so prior token -> 401; tokens w/o tv claim rejected. /api/payments/config returns {enabled:false,demo:true}; with PAYMENTS_DEMO_MODE=false UPI/Card bookings and wallet topup return 400 as expected while COD still places (verified end-to-end via test script); restored demo mode back to true after test. First-order coupon FIRST50 cannot be reused by customer with any prior non-payment_pending booking (incl. cancelled); cancellation path removed used_count decrement. Catalog ReDoS query q='(a+)+$' returns 200 in <2s; q='AC' still finds AC services. Transcribe: two POSTs within 3s -> second 429. CORS has allow_credentials=false and origin pinned to preview URL. Frontend (390x844): phone 9800000001 + OTP 1234 login works, lands on /home with session persisted in sessionStorage['hs_customer'] surviving reload, customer-logout-btn clears session and redirects to /login (old backend token revoked via 401). Checkout exposes pay-cod (default), pay-upi, pay-card, pay-wallet; Confirm Booking creates a COD booking (status pending, Total COD).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' in several screens (login/home). Non-blocking but should be migrated to RN 0.76+ boxShadow.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warnings on OTP/checkout screens.
'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported' falls back to JS animations on web. Benign on web preview.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate deprecated RN style props: shadow* -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents in src/* and app/* to silence warnings on RN 0.76+.
No functional fixes needed; all 4 security audit items pass.
critical_code_review_comments: core.get_current_user requires {sub,exp,iat,tv} claims and compares tv to user.token_version — tight, good.
seed.seed_admin uses $setOnInsert so changed password survives restarts — correct.
routes_customer.create_booking returns 400 when payment_method in (upi,card) and neither razorpay enabled nor demo_allowed — covers audit item 2.
cancel_booking no longer refunds coupon used_count (comment explicit); evaluate_coupon's first_order_only counts bookings with status != 'payment_pending' so cancelled bookings still block FIRST50.
catalog search uses re.escape and 60-char cap — ReDoS safe.
transcribe enforces per-user daily cap + 3s min gap before reading audio bytes, saving upstream credits.
CORSMiddleware allow_credentials=False and allow_origins from env (pinned preview URL).
